test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A trader mixes 20 kg of rice at Rs. 30 per kg with 20 kg of rice of other variety at Rs. 30 per kg and sells the mixture at Rs. 33 per kg. His profit percent is:
solution:
**Calculation:**

The average cost price is (30 +30) / 2 = Rs 30 per kg

The selling price is 33 per kg

Net profit 33 - 30 = Rs 3 per kg

The profit percentage will be,

⇒ (3 / 30) × 100 = 10%

**∴ The correct option is 1**
